findings.finding: H1 FY2/27 results and the FY forecast were pre-released on 2026-09-14 16:00 (H1 OP 1,548m->2,400m, +55%; ordinary 1,652m->2,480m; FY OP 3,265m->3,874m; dividend 74->82 JPY), the stock gapped +13.3% on 9/15 on 221,700 shares and has held the level, so the 短信 confirms rather than surprises; a late revision usually lands at or slightly above the actual, giving a small positive headline at most.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The revision itself was the event: 1,945 -> 2,204 (+13.3%) on 2026-09-15. On actual release dates (15:00, prev close -> next close) the name moved +0.3, +2.2, -1.4, +5.0, -2.0, -0.3, +3.6, -9.5, 0.0, +6.3, +1.2 since 2024-01; the -9.5% (2025-10-10) was an un-pre-released H1 decline (経常 -4%, 6-8月 -20%), the opposite setup to today.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the 9/15 gap and three weeks of holding at 2,250-2,340 are what a priced pre-release looks like. Only the gap between the actual and the 9/14 estimate is unpriced, and a revision filed two weeks after period end leaves little room.
findings.independence: kabutan k202609140081 and fisco n202609150814 report the same document; Yahoo daily bars show the 9/15 reaction. Same underlying document - counts once.

findings.finding: The revised FY guide implies H2 (Sep-Feb) operating profit of 1,474m (+9% YoY vs 1,350m) against an implied Q2 alone of 1,601m (+86% YoY, 10.5% margin) and H1 ordinary-profit progress of 62% of the FY plan against 51-56% in each of the last three years, so the print will show a high 進捗率 and an FY plan with visible headroom, which kabutan-style headlines flag as 上振れ余地.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-10 Q1 with progress 49.6% vs 5-year average 45.6% (kabutan): +1.2% prev close -> next close. 2024-10-08 record H1: +5.0%. No case found of a second FY raise four weeks after a first.
